labs.pi_title: Director of the Initiative on Cities
labs.research_summary: A Boston University initiative, founded in 2014 with Boston Mayor Tom Menino, that brings together urban leaders, policymakers, academics and students to work on livable, resilient cities.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 director, 1 executive director, 1 associate director, 1 communications manager and administrator, 1 MetroBridge faculty director, 1 MetroBridge program manager, 1 postdoctoral research associate, 3 graduate research assistants
labs.join_notes: The Internships & Fellowships page describes summer internships and fellowships for BU students placed with the City of Boston (equity, planning, streets), the Leventhal Map & Education Center and the Mayor's Office of New Urban Mechanics, and a Menino Fellowship with the National League of Cities with applications open for 2026-27. These are student programs. The Get Involved page also has a Join Our Team item with no text or link in the cached copy.
labs.notes: Count of 10 leaves out 3 visiting urban scholars, 4 student office/communications/multimedia assistants, 3 Urban-H associate directors (Katherine Levine Einstein, Dan Li, Stephanie Ettinger de Cuba) and 2 director emeriti. Including the student assistants would give 14.
